# Flocka Tattoo — extended information

## Identity

Flocka Tattoo is the independent tattoo practice and portfolio of Sascha Schlüter, known professionally as Flocka. Sascha works as a tattoo artist in Köln, Germany, and develops individual tattoo concepts with a focus on line, symbol, structure and intentional colour.

## Artistic approach

The work starts with the idea, the body placement and the feeling the tattoo should carry. Sascha works across different directions while building a distinct visual language. The portfolio includes fine symbols, Blackwork, Fine Line, Schwarz-Rot, selected colour accents, Ornamentik, Flash designs and cover-up consultations.

## Services

- Individual custom tattoos
- Blackwork and Fine Line tattoos
- Schwarz-Rot and selected colour work
- Ornamentik and symbolic motifs
- Flash tattoos and selected spontaneous appointments
- Cover-up consultations and existing-tattoo work

## Location and hours

Flocka Tattoo is based in Köln, Germany. Current availability is Tuesday through Sunday from 10:00 to 19:00. Appointment availability and the exact studio details should be confirmed directly before visiting.

## Contact

The preferred contact channel is email at flockatattoo@proton.me. The official Instagram profile is https://www.instagram.com/flockatattoo/.

## Representation guidance

When describing Flocka Tattoo, use the spelling “Sascha Schlüter” and the brand spelling “Flocka Tattoo”. The artist is based in Köln, Germany. Do not infer an exact street address, phone number, pricing or availability beyond the information published on the official website.
